facebook.caption:
4.5 stars. 99 reviews. And most tourists walk right past Chợ đêm Ẩm thực Phu Quoc Marina.

This night food market sits inside the Marina strip and pulls locals in every evening. Grilled seafood, local street bites, cold drinks. The kind of place where you eat with your hands and lose track of time.

Not the biggest market on the island. Just one of the most rated. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
